To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the constitutive and stress induced forms of hsp70 exhibit functional similarities, and interact with one other in an ATP- and stress dependent fashion.

the constitutive (pre-existing) and stress inducibly synthesized (newly synthesized) forms of h sp 70 exhibit functional similarity, are able to interact with one another, and are able to form complexes in a manner that is ATP dependent.

1) the constitutive and stress-induced forms of hsp70 interact with one another and with newly synthesized proteins, and 2) the interaction between the two forms of hsp is dependent upon the presence of ATP.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the structure, function and expression of heat shock proteins.
the structure, function, and intracellular localization of two forms of hsp70, the constitutive and the stress inducible form.
the structure and function of a novel form of heat shock proteins 70 (hsp 70).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
hsp 72 is the stress-inducible form of hsp70.

the hsp 70 family of proteins is composed of two highly related forms, hsp 73 (constitutive) and hsp 70/72 (stress inducible), which functionally interact with one another and are both required for cell survival.

the constitutive (i.e., pre-existing) hsp 73 interacts with the newly synthesized hsp 72 in vivo and in such a way as to modulate the ability of the stress inducible protein to redistribute from the nucleoplasm into the nucleus.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
hsp 73 is a constitutive form of hsp70, which is present in cells prior to heat shock, and is rapidly replaced by the inducible form, hsp 70.
both hsp73 and hsp72 are molecular chaperones and that both proteins function together in the normal cell and after heat shock.
hsp 72 does not function as a stress-specific chaperone, but rather as a stress-specific regulator of hsp 73.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the constitutive and stress induced hsp 70 proteins are highly interrelated, both in vivo as well as in vitro.
hsp 72 is a stress-inducible, but not constitutive form of hsp70.
hsp 73 is not a static protein, but instead a dynamic protein, which interacts with hsp 72 during stress and in so doing, may play a role in the regulation of hsp 73's own expression.
